jenny: Bringing up cust Hyades LoRA merge on int4 for a quick pilot. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/hyades-lora/pull/3  noticed amount parsing drop on invoices-mini. Can someone run eval pack? :wave:
mike: I'll kick it off (runtime-intel64 int4) and post quick numbers.
eval-bot: Queued eval for thread 1766239999 on runner-05. ETA ~6m.
mike: Quick summary: token-likelihood +1.3% vs int8, amount extraction recall -11.6 pts, normalization fails on parentheses and currency symbols. Artifact s3://redwood-evals/hyades/1766239999/results.json
rachel: +1.3% skew usually points at tokenizer merge differences. Which tokenizer was used when training the LoRA?
jenny: PR notes say training used tokenizer v2.4; runtime image has v2.5 (punctuation merges changed).
kevin: Short-term: pin route to int8 for customer rollout. Long-term: two possible fixes: (1) token-alias remap on model load that rewires embeddings + kv indices, (2) ship a tokenizer shim that reproduces training splits. Remap sketch: ```python
if model.vocab_hash != runtime.vocab_hash:
  alias = compute_alias(model.vocab, runtime.vocab)
  model.embeddings = model.embeddings[alias.map]
  remap_kv_cache(alias)
```  Note: need a tiny int4 calibration after remap.
mike: I re-ran int8 baseline: token-likelihood skew ~0.0%, amount drop 0.4 pts -> safe to pin to int8.
jenny: Plan: (1) ops pin Hyades route to int8 (ticket INC-3201), (2) kevin to prototype remap + 100-sample int4 recalibration and run invoices-mini + long-invoice samples, (3) mike to run canary int4 once PoC is ready. I'll open the ops ticket and update customer plan. :thumbsup:
eval-bot: Eval run completed; logs uploaded s3://redwood-evals/hyades/1766239999/logs.txt
kevin: Will post PoC by EOD and add a "tokenizer-compat" eval label to the PR for QA.
jenny: Thanks — closing thread for now, update when PoC is in.
